Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up earlier prototype normal save, including 0024 or 0025 through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. This is an incremental Route 5 checkpoint. Yellow map geometry, the Saffron drink roadblock and later campaign areas remain unfinished. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Route 5 has Yellow’s weighted grass encounters at all times of day, its Underground Path sign and no inherited outdoor NPC. Its existing HeartGold house provides native Day Care services sharing Johto’s deposited Pokémon and interactions. Deposit, withdrawal and normal save/reload were checked on private save copies. Yellow’s Day Care placement and route geometry are still being rebuilt; egg handling has not been tested. The full Oak intro and naming screens, approved customizations and Johto resources carry forward unchanged. Use Continue with a backed-up normal save, not a cross-version emulator state. Earlier checkpoints remain available.
